title: HP (HPQ) Names Emma Walmsley CEO as Bruce Broussard Becomes Board Chair
summary: HP (NYSE:HPQ) named former GSK chief Emma Walmsley as its next CEO, succeeding Bruce Broussard. Broussard will move from the chief executive role to become Chair of HP's Board as part of the transition. Walmsley brings prior CEO experience at GSK and currently serves on Microsoft's Board, adding big-cap and tech governance expertise.
